'''Talia''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was lived on [[Mina-Rau]]. She met [[Brasso]] and the pair entered into a relationship together.

==Biography==
Talia moved to the agricultural farm world [[Mina-Rau]]<ref name="Databank" /> around [[12 BBY]].<ref name="MoveDate">Talia states in {{Andor|One Year Later}} that she had been on Mina-Rau for eight years. As that episode states that it occurs during 4 BBY then Talia must have moved to Mina-Rau c. 12 BBY.</ref> By [[4 BBY]], Talia had become a documented worker on Mina-Rau.<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref> Talia had also met<ref name="Databank" /> a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] named [[Brasso]] who had fled [[Ferrix]] with his friends [[Bix Caleen]], [[Wilmon Paak]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor]], and [[B2EMO]] after [[Ferrix Riot|rioting]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rix Road">{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}</ref> She eventually fell for Brasso and the two became a couple and started to build a life together. During their time together she provided some financial support as well as emotional support for B2EMO.<ref name="Databank" />

One night while sleeping next to Brasso in the [[mobil-haus]] they shared with Caleen, Andor, Paak and B2EMO, the group was woken up by the sound of Caleen having a nightmare. She and Brasso tried to comfort Caleen before the group went back to bed. The next day the group learned that the Empire was conducting a [[Imperial Supply Census]], which had not previously occurred in all the time that Talia lived on Mina-Rau. Later that day, Talia tried to comfort Caleen, Brasso and Paak who were worrying that the Empire might checked visa which the three did not have.<ref name="One Year Later" /> The following night Talia joined the group when they met with [[Kellen]], shop owner on Mina-Rau, who told them about the Empire's movement on Mina-Rau. Talia offered to say she lived in the mobil-haus since she had a visa.<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref> The following day she attended a communal gathering between local [[farmer]]s and [[Technician|mechanics]] on Mina-Rau. During that gathering she brought a bowl of [[stew]] to Brasso and a couple of farmers playfully joked about the couple's relationship. After the gathering B2EMO stayed with Talia while the others went back to the mobil-haus to pack.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Personality and traits==
Talia was a<ref name="One Year Later" /> female<ref name="One Year Later AD" /> human with light skin, [[color|blue]] [[eye]]s, and red [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
Talia had several outfits, wearing blue [[clothing|shirt]] and tan pants on one occasion<ref name="One Year Later" /> and blue shirt with a gray skirt the following day.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talia was portrayed by [[Claire Brown]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's first episode, "[[One Year Later]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> Talia's entry on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] mistakenly used an image of [[Aneth]],<ref name="TaliaOriginal">{{Databank|talia|Talia|oldversion=20250423023621}}</ref> another resident of Mina-Rau,<ref name="One Year Later" /> when it was first posted.<ref name="TaliaOriginal" />
